about: The route through Lanka, section by section: what each place looks like, what blocks the way, where the story beats, fights, forks and camera shots fall. Distances in metres. Difficulty rises along the route: obstacle rows get closer and the run gets faster. A section with a "kind" is built and playable, in whole 24 m stretches; the fire run goes back through the places listed in "through".

sources.epic: Valmiki Ramayana, Sundara Kanda (the search for Sita, the burning of Lanka) and Yuddha Kanda sarga 3 (Hanuman's own description of Lanka's defences: four gates with strong doors and locking beams, engines that hurl darts and stones, iron sataghnis kept by the hundred at the gates, deep moats with crocodiles, drawbridges worked by engines).
sources.fort: Arthashastra fort chapter: triple moats with crocodiles, ramparts, towers, archers' positions, iron-pointed stakes.

lamp.what: A small floating oil-lamp flame, Rama's name. Fills the strength meter.

wind.what: A swirl of wind, the blessing of his father Vayu. He flies over everything for a few seconds.

ring.what: Rama's signet ring, carried from the start and given to Sita in the grove.

jewel.what: Sita's hair jewel, carried from the grove to the end.

giant.what: Meter full, tap: he grows huge and smashes through everything.

flight.what: Flies above the lanes; obstacles and guards pass underneath.

thrown-pots.from: guards throw them into his path

fire-arrows.from: epic: engines and archers on the walls; a lane is marked before they land

hurled-stone.from: epic: engines that hurl stones; a shadow marks the lane

sataghni.from: epic: spiked iron log dropped at the gates

closing-door.from: epic: strong doors with locking beams

sections.name: The Gate
sections.place: sea gate of Lanka at night

events.what: opening: slow pass over the gate and walls, down to Hanuman
the guardian of the city blocks the gate; one clean strike fells her (as in the epic)
a guard sees him; the chase begins

events.left: rooftops: more lamps, gaps to leap

sections.name: The Bridges
sections.place: stone bridges over the moat, crocodiles below

events.what: wide side view of him running the bridge with the palace above, slow motion on the first leap

sections.name: The Stairway
sections.place: the grand stairway up to the palace, sloping up

sections.name: The Palace Court
sections.place: outer palace court behind the great doors

events.what: the great doors swing shut; he slides under the locking beam
the run stops, he fights with the mace, then runs on

sections.name: The Inner Palace
sections.place: pillared halls and corridors of gold and dark stone

events.what: high gliding view down the pillared hall
he gives Sita the ring and receives her hair jewel
he wrecks the grove and fights; ends when he is bound and taken before Ravana
before Ravana; his tail is wrapped and set on fire

sections.name: Lanka Burns
sections.place: back down through the palace, the stairway and the city, everything catching fire

events.what: low angle as the tail catches; slow motion
he leaps from the gate tower over the sea, the city burning behind him
